Smart Derm is an AI-powered skin cancer prediction system designed to detect and classify skin lesions fromimages using
deep learning. Built with a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) trained on the HAM10000 dataset, the system analyzes
uploaded skin lesion images to predict whether the lesion is benign or malignant

Built an AI-powered assistive navigation system for visually impaired individuals using Python, OpenCV, YOLOv8, and
Machine Learning. Designed and implemented a real-time computer vision pipeline for obstacle detection, object recognition,
and distance estimation using webcam input. Integrated pyttsx3 for voice-based alerts and guidance, enabling safe navigation
through audio feedback. Optimized detection performance for improved accuracy, reduced latency, and enhanced accessibility
in real-world environments.
